positive.not_applicable_reason: Every context has a separate counts-only control batch through all six arms, with the first available pair sum planted by word arithmetic. Empty bases retain a negative-only control and are never resampled. These are per-context controls rather than a separate treatment arm.

negative.not_applicable_reason: The same per-context batch includes the first generator-walk point missing from the complete word-arithmetic pair sumset. Full-sumset contexts retain their positive-only control; do not invent an impossible negative or resample. Every ordinary negative answer also receives complete word replay.

seed_derivation.note: native-point-hash-pilot/v1 SHA256 rejection law; order_seed=0x706f696e74686173. Context and arm blocks reverse on the second round of each pair.

instance_sampling.rule: Registered prime roster, full 2x2x8 context grid; SHA256-rejection uniform subgroup query points and separate base RNG. No scalar labels enter child input.

blinding.how: Prototype counts-only analysis is unmasked. Canonical masked export/analysis is an explicit unresolved admission dependency; no winner or statistical promotion.

power.note: Exploratory count ratios: 5 candidate/current contrasts x 4 cells x 5 prefixes x 3 diagnostic metrics. No error-controlled test or promotion. Eight independent base-seed clusters per cell; repetitions/queries are not independent sample units. Test-specific power is unqualified and must be set for fresh-target confirmation.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly 192 per-context planted/negative controls + 64 forced-hash-collision controls + 192 counted diagnostic batches + 384 warmup + 1536 measured = 2368 planned child attempts. Controls/counts precede timing.
Stop at the first child/replay/resource/timeout failure, preserving the durable start/finish ledger and all remaining unattempted rows. Never retry or extend the original absolute deadline.
No build or study unless current account/lane charged-plus-reserved headroom, exact-source S3 checkpoint/readback and authenticated native image/L2 admission pass.

invalidation_rules: Mismatched input/schedule/artifact identity; duplicate or out-of-order ledger events.
Incorrect witness/absence or a resource limit labelled absent.
Timing below required native L2, missing host/resource inventory or any resumed interval.
Any missing/failed row prevents a complete-case count contrast; retain full flow instead.

decision_rule.text: Report deterministic paired diagnostic ratios by size/threshold/prefix, with independent base-seed clusters and descriptive pointwise intervals. Do not declare a winner, infer equivalence, promote a runtime gain or claim fastest implementation. Timing comparisons are refused by the prototype analyzer.
decision_rule.statistic: Ratio of totals across one counted record per independent base-seed context; candidate/current; root/add/meter prefixes.
decision_rule.interval: Existing ecbench.stats linearised_ratio, log-scale Student-t pointwise 95% interval over 8 independent base seeds; no query/timing-repeat pseudoreplication.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Unpriced diagnostic count ratios only; no error-controlled multiple-comparison decision.

inadmissible: Changing grid, query law, seeds, accounting or stopping after seeing native study data.
Reading development F17 controls or unpriced count ratios as runtime gains.
Using pointwise pilot intervals as multiplicity-corrected evidence or proof of equivalence.
Substituting an unrelated ECBench fixture or local timings for an admitted native study.
Treating a null freeze, unknown budget, a source label or a producer boolean as execution admission.
Dropping failures, duplicate/in-flight attempts, empty bases or full-sumset control exceptions.
